text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the
academy, I
see a group of students
buzzing with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Exactly, exactly! And then the retriever
at the
dog cafe came and snuggled right
up to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a single Umamusume comes
charging
towards the group with
astonishing momentum.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eep! K-K-Kris S?! ...C-can we help you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So... none of you even realized?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Oh no! W-were we, um, being too loud?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't my intention. I failed to
complete my
task...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
One of them dropped this. I came to
give it back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I'll just try again. No problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: This time... I'll be more gentle.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: This time... I'll be more gentle.
choice_data_list: You really don't let it get you down, huh.
You really don't let it get you down, do you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I must return this safely and securely.
That is the
duty of one who finds a lost
item.
choice_data_list: You really don't let it get you down, huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But your encouragement is...

unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I have someone who I know is always in
my
corner. That is enough.
